issue.title: ACE AgentFilePanel and AgentPromptPanel paint long content into one Static and may re-render every row

task_type_fields.impact: Possible UI stalls in the ACE Agents tab when showing long agent files or prompts. Severity is unmeasured; the content cap limits the worst case.
task_type_fields.repro: Proposed by sase-1es.8 (note #3). Before 54427ed47c, the pager's `_layout.py` docstring named `AgentFilePanel` and `AgentPromptPanel` as using the same "one big renderable, Textual virtualizes the rows" shape. Epic sase-1es proved that assumption false for the pager: `Static` renders and caches every row, and every repaint repeats O(document) work. Confirmed on current master: `AgentFilePanel` (src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/file_panel/_panel.py:28) subclasses `Static`, with content capped at FILE_PANEL_MAX_RENDER_LINES = PLAIN_RENDER_MAX_LINES = 5,000 lines (src/sase/pager/hint_budgets.py:27). `AgentPromptPanel` (src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/__init__.py:38) renders the agent detail document. The 5k cap bounds the worst case, but every refresh, theme change, or resize of a near-cap file can still re-render thousands of rows on the event loop. Measure first: time a full refresh and a scroll key on a 5k-line diff in the Agents tab file panel (and a long prompt in the prompt panel) with SASE_TUI_TRACE=1. If cost scales with content, move the body to a Line-API ScrollView the way the pager did.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1es found the pager's one-big-Static body re-rendered every row; the same shape is used by these ACE panels, which the old pager docstring cited as precedent.

payload.description: The tui_perf.md rule records the one-big-Static scaling problem these panels may share
